name: frappe-fullstack
description: Comprehensive Frappe/ERPNext full-stack development with DocType scaffolding, bench integration, and specialized agents for server-side Python, client-side JavaScript, and ERPNext customization

bench_path.title: Bench root
bench_path.description: Absolute path to your frappe-bench directory (the one containing apps/, sites/, env/).

default_site.title: Default site
default_site.description: Default site name for bench commands (e.g. dev.localhost). Override per-command with --site.

python_path.title: Python interpreter
python_path.description: Optional. Path to bench's Python (usually <bench_path>/env/bin/python). Leave blank to detect.
